games.title: Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior, Redneck Rampage and PowerSlave for iPhone
games.page_title: Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior on iPhone: Raze for iOS (unofficial)
games.description: Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior, Redneck Rampage and PowerSlave on iPhone and iPad with touch controls: an unofficial Raze port. Bring your own game files.
games.lead: Five Build engine classics in one app: Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior, Redneck Rampage and PowerSlave, on iPhone and iPad, with touch controls.
games.need: You need your own copies of the games (Steam or GOG). No game files are included.

screenshots.alt: Duke Nukem 3D, Hollywood Holocaust: an Octabrain, Assault Troopers and a Pig Cop on the rooftop, with the shrinker and the game's own status bar split into the two corners
Duke Nukem 3D: a pipe bomb in hand as a Pig Cop, an Assault Trooper and an Octabrain close in, with the iOS HUD panels
Blood: the tommy gun fires at a cultist, shells flying over a coffin
Shadow Warrior: Lo Wang draws his katana in the Dojo of Death
Shadow Warrior: two Uzis against a ninja up close
Redneck Rampage: the shotgun on a dirt road under a red sky, a chicken and three locals ahead
PowerSlave: a mummy in a sunlit temple courtyard, flamethrower in hand

games.shots_note: All from the game running on a computer, with the game's own files, not from an iPhone.
features: **Five games, one app.** A card for each game you copied in; hold a card for its add-ons (Duke It Out in D.C., Nuclear Winter, Cryptic Passage, Twin Dragon, Rides Again and more).
**Touch controls made for these games.** A stick under your left thumb, drag to look, FIRE with JUMP, USE and CROUCH round it, KICK in Duke and ALT FIRE in Blood.
**Weapon wheel.** Slide from NEXT WPN or PREV WPN and pick a weapon by its own picture, with its ammo.
**A button for every item you carry,** with the item's own picture: Duke's jetpack and HoloDuke, Blood's crystal ball, Lo Wang's smoke bombs. Duke's jetpack flies where you look.
**Six HUD looks,** among them the game's own status bar split into the two bottom corners.
**60 or 120 frames a second,** drawn with Vulkan on Metal. Sharp or smooth pixels, and smoother textures if you like.
**CAMERA:** photos, bursts, selfies with the enemies posing, Action Freeze and a cinematic burst, straight to your Photos.
**The cheat** (sithewok): god mode, every weapon, full ammo, walk through walls, fly in Shadow Warrior. **LEVEL** jumps to any level.
**Tilt aiming,** quick save and quick load on a short hold, game controllers, and LAN multiplayer on Wi-Fi (see below).
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, so please expect bugs, and back up your saves. **Multiplayer especially:** LAN games have only been tried between copies of the game on one computer, never between two real iPhones, so they may not connect or may fall out of step. Sorry; it's being worked on.
Found a bug? Please [report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/Raze-iOS-/issues), not to upstream Raze.
thanks: **[Raze](https://github.com/ZDoom/Raze)** by Christoph Oelckers and Mitchell Richters, with the [ZDoom and GZDoom](https://zdoom.org/) teams and contributors.
**Ken Silverman**, for the [Build engine](http://www.advsys.net/ken).
**3D Realms**, who released the Duke Nukem 3D and Shadow Warrior source code.
**Jonathon Fowler** (JonoF) for JFDuke3D, and the **[EDuke32](https://eduke32.com/)** team: Richard Gobeille (TerminX), Evan Ramos (Hendricks266), pogokeen, Plagman and Helixhorned.
**[NBlood](https://github.com/nukeykt/NBlood)** by Nuke.YKT, NoOne and sirlemonhead (Blood), and Nuke.YKT's reconstructed Redneck Rampage source.
**VoidSW** and SWP (Shadow Warrior), **PCExhumed** by sirlemonhead, Nuke.YKT and NY00123 (PowerSlave), and BuildGDX by M210.
The games' makers: 3D Realms, Monolith Productions, Xatrix Entertainment and Lobotomy Software.

[SDL](https://www.libsdl.org/), [OpenAL Soft](https://openal-soft.org/), [ZMusic](https://github.com/ZDoom/ZMusic), [libvpx](https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx) and [MoltenVK](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/MoltenVK).

games.shots_note: From the game running on a computer, with the cheat on; the enemies were brought together for the pictures.
features: **Touch controls made for Serious Sam:** a move stick wherever your left thumb lands, drag anywhere to look, and FIRE, JUMP, USE and CROUCH under your right thumb. LOOK sets how fast dragging turns (0.5x to 3x).
**A weapon wheel:** slide off NEXT WPN or PREV WPN and every weapon you carry is laid out round your thumb, with its icon and ammo. In single player the game holds still while you pick.

**CAMERA, with selfies:** tap for a photo, slide for a burst. Hold it for a **selfie**: up to 48 of the nearest enemies pose round Sam, frozen in moves from their own animations. Photos go straight to your Photos app.

**Action Freeze:** slide CAMERA down and the fight stops mid-explosion; fly the camera round it and take your shot. Slide up for a **cinematic burst**, five photos as the camera sweeps round the action.
**A cheat for relaxed play,** sithewok: god mode, endless ammo, flying, walking through walls, being caught when you fall into a pit, and a list of every level to jump to.
**Tilt aiming** (gyro), if you want it: OFF, TOUCH (while a thumb is down) or ALWAYS.
**60 or 120 frames a second,** drawn through ANGLE on Metal, Apple's modern graphics system.
**Quick save and quick load** on a short hold, so a stray tap can't undo your progress.
**Network games:** co-op, scorematch and fragmatch with friends on the same Wi-Fi (SEARCH LAN finds them), with the games' own multiplayer and the same touch controls.
**A HUD that fits** notched and Dynamic Island screens, the iPhone keyboard for the game's text boxes, and sound even with the phone on silent.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, and it has bugs. Thank you for trying it anyway. Back up your saves now and then (the release page says where they are).

Found a bug? Please [report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/issues), not to the upstream SeriousSamClassic project. Say which app, which iPhone, and the build (hold MENU: it's under the tray, for example build 41 · Nov 17).
thanks: **[Croteam](https://github.com/Croteam-official/Serious-Engine)**, for making Serious Sam, and for releasing Serious Engine 1's source code to everyone, under the GNU GPL v2, in 2016.

**[tx00100xt](https://github.com/tx00100xt)**, who maintains **[SeriousSamClassic](https://github.com/tx00100xt/SeriousSamClassic)**, the cross-platform version this is forked from. It keeps both games building on Linux, the BSDs, macOS and more, and added widescreen support for the menus, NETRICSA and the HUD, which every iPhone screen needs.

The people who first brought the engine beyond Windows, whose work SeriousSamClassic carries on: **[Ryan C. Gordon](https://github.com/icculus)** (the first Linux port), **[ptitSeb](https://github.com/ptitSeb)** (ARM and handheld ports, and **gl4es**, which these apps draw with), **[Daniel Gibson](https://github.com/DanielGibson)**, **[zcaliptium](https://github.com/zcaliptium)**, and every contributor in the [change log](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/blob/ios/CHANGELOG.old).
**[SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL)**, **[ANGLE](https://github.com/google/angle)** and **[Xiph.Org](https://xiph.org/)** (Ogg Vorbis, for the music).

games.shots_note: All from the game running on a computer, with the game's own files, not from an iPhone.
features: **Touch controls made for DOOM 3:** a move stick wherever your left thumb lands, with a run marker above it; drag anywhere else to look; FIRE with JUMP, CROUCH, RELOAD and the flashlight round it.
**A weapon wheel:** slide off NEXT WPN and every weapon is there, with its ammo.
**Tilt aiming (gyro)**, a look speed to suit your thumb, SAVE and LOAD that open the game's own pages with a tap and quick save or load with a short hold, and an OPACITY slider for the buttons.

**CAMERA:** photos of the game without the HUD, selfies, bursts, **Action Freeze** (stop the world and fly a camera round it) and a **cinematic burst** that sweeps round you. They go to your Photos app.
**The PDA by touch:** tap to click, drag to scroll the emails and logs.
**Both games in one app,** with a main menu laid out for the phone.
**Cheat mode** for a relaxed run: god mode, every weapon with endless ammo, a cheat menu (Noclip, Notarget, Slow motion), and a list of every level to jump to.
**Multiplayer and co-op** (from [LibreCoop](https://github.com/Stradex/librecoop)), on the same Wi-Fi or by address. Not tested yet: see below.
**Sound with the phone on silent,** as a game should be.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, made by a fan and played by very few people so far. Expect bugs, and save often.
Found a bug? [Report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/doom3-ios/issues), not to dhewm3 or LibreCoop. Every report helps.
thanks: **id Software**, who made DOOM 3 and released its source code under the GPL in 2011 ([id-Software/DOOM-3](https://github.com/id-Software/DOOM-3)).
**Daniel Gibson and the dhewm3 contributors**, who have kept that code running on today's computers for over a decade ([dhewm3](https://github.com/dhewm/dhewm3)). This app is dhewm3 1.5.5 underneath.

**Tom Kidd** ([tomkidd](https://github.com/tomkidd)), whose [DOOM3-iOS](https://github.com/tomkidd/DOOM3-iOS) this repository was forked from, with contributions from Dave Nicolson and Yoshi Sugawara. Its OpenGL ES renderer still draws the game here.
**Gabriel Cuvillier**, for [d3wasm](https://github.com/gabrielcuvillier/d3wasm), DOOM 3 in a web browser, whose OpenGL ES work that renderer shares.
**Stradex**, for [LibreCoop](https://github.com/Stradex/librecoop), the co-op and survival modes.
The people behind [SDL](https://www.libsdl.org), [OpenAL Soft](https://openal-soft.org) and [ANGLE](https://chromium.googlesource.com/angle/angle).

games.shots_note: From the game running on a computer, with the game's own files; some enemies were moved into place for the pictures.
features: **Widescreen at a steady 60 frames a second**, in crisp, sharp pixels.

**Touch controls made for the game.** The move stick appears wherever your left thumb lands; slide up onto the little ^^ to run. Drag anywhere else to turn. FIRE, USE, MAP (the automap) and NEXT WPN are where your thumbs are.
**A weapon wheel.** Slide NEXT WPN and pick knife, pistol, machine gun or chain gun from a wheel; the game waits while it's open.
**Quick save and quick load** with a short hold on SAVE or LOAD.
**Six HUD looks.** A modern one with BJ's face, health, lives, ammo and keys in two small pills, or the original status bar (whole, or split to the corners), in three sizes, with an opacity slider.

**A camera.** Take photos of the action, bursts, and selfies: BJ grins in the corner while the guards and dogs around you pose for the group shot. **Action Freeze** stops time so you can fly the camera around the moment. Pictures go to your Photos.

**The sithewok cheat.** Type it, or switch it on from the menu: a golden Ark of the Covenant button opens, and you get god mode, every weapon, every key and full ammo. Hold USE to walk through walls (noclip).
**Jump to any level** from a list, in Wolfenstein 3D or Spear of Destiny.
**All your games in one app.** Have both games' files? Switch between them from the menu.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, made by a fan, so expect bugs. Sorry about them! Back up your saves (Files > On My iPhone > Wolf3D > ECWolf) before you update or reinstall.
Found a bug? Please [report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/ECWolf/issues), not to upstream ECWolf.
thanks: **Braden "Blzut3" Obrzut** and the ECWolf contributors, for [ECWolf](https://maniacsvault.net/ecwolf/) ([source](https://github.com/ECWolfEngine/ECWolf)): years of careful work that keep Wolfenstein 3D playing well on today's machines, with widescreen, modern controls and a great automap.
**Moritz "Ripper" Kroll**, for Wolf4SDL, the SDL port of the original code that ECWolf grew from.
**id Software** (John Carmack, John Romero, Adrian Carmack, Tom Hall and the team), for making Wolfenstein 3D and Spear of Destiny, and for releasing the source code in 1995.
**Randy Heit, Christoph Oelckers and Teemu Piippo**, whose ZDoom code ECWolf builds on.
**The SDL team** (Sam Lantinga and contributors), for SDL, SDL_mixer and SDL_net, and the **DOSBox** and **MAME** teams, for the OPL sound emulators that play the game's music.
